label: coach_bb_sister_sp01_00
text: Look at that—you came to say hi all on your own!\nFinally learning some manners, huh?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: coach_bb_sister_sp01_01
text: Anyways, hey! Kiki’s back in school, which means\nI am too![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: coach_bb_sister_sp01_02
text: So whenever you see me, you’d better come say\nhi—within two seconds flat! No dillydallying![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: coach_bb_sister_sp01_select_01
text: You got it!

label: coach_bb_sister_sp01_select_02
text: Do I have to...?

label: coach_bb_sister_sp01_03
text: Really? Didn’t think you’d agree just like that!\nYou didn’t hit your head or anything, did you?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: coach_bb_sister_sp01_03b
text: Ehehehe! That sour look you get is the best—I\njust love it![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: coach_bb_sister_sp01_04
text: It’s weird to be back in school, though... I was in\nKitakami long enough that it feels crowded here.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: coach_bb_sister_sp01_05
text: You know how Mossui Town is—there’s just\nnothing there! I mean, that’s what I like about it,\r\nbut still.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: coach_bb_sister_sp02_01
text: You didn’t take any videos or anything of me\ndoing that mochi-mochi dance, right?![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: coach_bb_sister_sp02_select_01
text: None at all

label: coach_bb_sister_sp02_select_02
text: Well, actually...

label: coach_bb_sister_sp02_02
text: Oh, thank goodness! I know a Pokémon was\ncontrolling me and everything, but it’s still the\r\nmost embarrassing thing I’ve ever done![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: coach_bb_sister_sp02_02b
text: WHAT?! Delete it! Delete everything, right now![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: coach_bb_sister_sp02_03
text: How do you think that’d look when I become\nfamous? I’d never hear the end of it![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: coach_bb_sister_sp02_04
text: What was the whole deal with that Pokémon,\nanyway? Pecharunt, right?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: coach_bb_sister_sp02_05
text: Is it just me, or does something about it remind\nyou of the Lousy Three?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: coach_bb_sister_sp02_select_03
text: Yeah, kinda!

label: coach_bb_sister_sp02_select_04
text: You think?

label: coach_bb_sister_sp02_06
text: I swear it’s not just my imagination. I bet they’re\nconnected somehow![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: coach_bb_sister_sp02_07
text: But it’s not like we can ask the Pokémon about all\nthis... I guess the truth will always be a mystery![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: coach_bb_sister_sp03_00
text: Come to say hi all on your own, eh? Good, good![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: coach_bb_sister_sp03_01
text: Hey, so, um... How’re things with Kiki these days?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: coach_bb_sister_sp03_select_01
text: We get along great!

label: coach_bb_sister_sp03_select_02
text: All right, I guess

label: coach_bb_sister_sp03_02
text: Oh? Well, that’s good.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: coach_bb_sister_sp03_02b
text: Well, that’s better than bad, at least...[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: coach_bb_sister_sp03_03
text: He’s...working hard now. Trying to make things\nright with the school, the club—everything.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: coach_bb_sister_sp03_04
text: I’d like it if you could support—actually, no,\nforget I said anything. Just be his friend, OK?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: coach_bb_sister_sp03_select_03
text: Of course!

label: coach_bb_sister_sp03_select_04
text: If you say so!

label: coach_bb_sister_sp03_05
text: Yeah... Why am I even asking? You two are\nfriends already![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: coach_bb_sister_sp03_05b
text: Yeah! Make sure he has a solid friend, so I can\nstop worrying![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: coach_bb_sister_sp03_06
text: Seriously though, maybe I’m a bit overprotective,\nhuh?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: coach_bb_sister_sp03_07
text:
I guess I’ll try to dial it back a little... I’ll still keep
an eye on him, but I won’t overdo it.\c
Makes me feel kinda lonely thinking about it,
though...[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: coach_bb_sister_trade_01_00
text: Aw, now I’m getting all sentimental.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: coach_bb_sister_trade_01_01
text: This is your fault, y’know. You need to do\nsomething to cheer me up![VAR 0x0114(0044)]
